name: Abyssin du Grand Large
description: Nautile cartographe traçant les routes migratoires sûres à travers les courants stellaires les plus dangereux.

subject.archetype: Abyssal Nautilus Cartographer – Cephalopod Navigator of the Great Deep

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavy mineral‑mining exosuit with thick polymer underlayer; massive curved glass dome helmet (the Bocal) filled with cyan luminescent fluid; orange‑rust, verdigris, and gun‑metal armor plates; exposed copper tubing, hydraulic joints, pressure valves, and steam vents
loadout.arsenal: Integrated thermal plasma cutter arm, high‑frequency plasma saw, stellar‑current sensor array, holographic star‑map projector

attitude.behavior: Hovering in mid‑air, tentacles trailing, one arm raised with a blazing orange plasma cutter; projecting a luminous stellar‑current map from the helmet’s visor; scanning the surrounding currents with a cyan‑glowing sensor lens
attitude.emotion: Calm, focused, with a fierce determination reflected in the cold alien gaze

palette_names.name: Rust Orange (oxidized Martian/terrestrial)
palette_names.role: Primary armor tone, main body plating

palette_names.name: Verdigris (copper oxide green)
palette_names.role: Secondary patina on copper components, decorative details

palette_names.name: Gunmetal Gray (tarnished cannon)
palette_names.role: Hard mechanical parts, joints, weapon housings

palette_names.name: Cyan Bioluminescent
palette_names.role: Helmet fluid glow, bioluminescent skin patches, energy accents

palette_names.name: Orange Thermal (blinding plasma)
palette_names.role: Weapon glow, plasma jets, heat vents

palette_names.name: Pale Violet / Gray Pearl (alien skin)
palette_names.role: Translucent cephalopod epidermis, subtle skin highlights

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Multi‑source cinematic lighting: a cold cyan rim light from the helmet fluid, a harsh orange directional light from the plasma cutter, ambient fog and faint halos; OSL (object‑based global illumination) applied to all glowing elements
color_and_light.mood: Menacing, mysterious, epic; tension between industrial decay and high‑tech power

scenography.setting: Abyssal deep‑sea dock on a dark oceanic planet, with massive industrial platforms, floating cargo pods, and a star‑filled cavernous ceiling; swirling stellar currents visualized as luminous ribbons in the background
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Steamy vapor rising from pressure vents, drifting cyan bioluminescent particles, orange plasma sparks and occasional geysers of boiling water, subtle rain of micro‑particles, foggy haze, faint holographic star‑map overlay
